profile.ovpn_config:

dev tun
proto udp
remote 138.199.204.139 1194
resolv-retry infinite
nobind
persist-key
persist-tun
remote-cert-tls server
data-ciphers AES-256-GCM:AES-128-GCM
cipher AES-256-GCM
auth SHA256
auth-user-pass
auth-nocache
verb 3
dhcp-option DNS 94.140.14.14
dhcp-option DNS 94.140.15.15
<ca>
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
MIIBPLACEHOLDER
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
</ca>
